title: Chapter 179 Attacking Tianze Village
content:
Chapter 179 Attacking Tianze Village

On the military camp grounds, Wang Shuo was hesitant whether to send the archer camp to participate in the battle.

I checked their loyalty points and it was only 82 points.

Wang Shuo thought for a while and gave up on this decision.

We also recruited 50 tool people from the resource exchange office.

He handed it over to Li Jianguo, formed a ballista battalion, and also allocated to him two light catapults that the craftsman battalion rushed to build overnight.

Wang Shuo stood on the general stage, briefly boosted his morale, and then set off towards Fengze Village with a total of more than 350 people from the Black Mountain bandits, Golden Fire Cavalry and Ballista Battalion.

Since there were not many horses, they launched a siege.

Therefore, the role of the cavalry would probably be severely reduced, so Wang Shuo directly ordered two horses to transport people back and forth.

Two hours later, all the personnel had gathered in a small mountain col less than 10 miles away from Fengze Village.

Taking advantage of the break, Wang Shuo sent two cavalry teams to investigate the situation near Fengze Village.

I found that everything was normal, and there were even farmers farming outside the village.

It seems that the opponent has not realized that he is going to attack Fengze Village.

I rested for another hour, ate some food, and adjusted myself.

At 11:30 noon, it was time to eat. Wang Shuo took all the troops and rushed to Fengze Village.

It didn't take long for Fengze Village to appear in Wang Shuo's sight.

It was only then that the people of Fengze Village discovered that there was a large group of people in the distance, heading towards their village.

"Report."

Zhao Tianze is enjoying delicious food in his mansion. Although his subjects are short of food, as a lord, he cannot treat himself badly.

Zhao Tianze was obviously unhappy when he saw the soldiers who broke in.

"What's the matter? You're so frizzy and unbecoming." Zhao Tianze glanced at the soldier with disgust.

He originally thought that being a lord meant being an emperor, and that it should be relaxing and comfortable.

But I didn’t expect that there would be endless things to deal with all day long.

He has to worry about everything, but he dare not delegate power for fear that his subordinates will rebel against him.

"A group of soldiers appeared outside the village, and it seemed they were going to attack our village."

When Zhao Tianze heard this, his expression changed, he stood up, threw away the chopsticks in his hand, and exclaimed: "What? How many people are there on the other side?"

"About two to three hundred people."

Zhao Tianze hurriedly walked out.

Because Fengze Village is developing so fast, the population growth rate is much faster than the territory's infrastructure construction.

So far, the development of the territory has been very abnormal.

There are already four military camps, but the residential buildings can only accommodate half of the people. After all, the entire village's population has reached nearly 2,000 people.

What's more important is that the fence has not been completed yet, and some areas are still covered with fences.

Standing on the low wall, Zhao Tianze saw Wang Shuo's army in formation in the distance.

Because of the distance, he didn't recognize whose army it was.

Wang Shuo was currently 2.5 kilometers away from the village. He arranged the Black Mountain bandits in an arc shape, with the ballista battalion surrounding them in the center.

The Golden Fire Cavalry did not appear here, but was hidden in the dense forest in the distance.

Only the hidden cavalry can become a surprise force!

If the opponent doesn't come out, just keep bombarding them with catapults. If the opponent comes out, hum, then they will be stepped on the ground by the cavalry and rubbed repeatedly!

Wang Shuo felt that his tactics were very good, and there was a look of pride on his face.
